transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our maintenance coordination meeting started. We've got four work orders to assign across four available work windows in the maintenance bay: Generator G-2 service, Communications Shelter C-1 inspection, Forklift F-4 steering repair, and HVAC Unit H-3 service. The available windows are Friday 1000-1200, Friday 1300-1500, Saturday 0800-1000, and Saturday 1000-1200. Before I publish the final maintenance plan, I need to hear from each of you on any requirements, constraints, or special considerations for these work orders. Who wants to start?

This arrival isn't reflected on the maintenance board yet, but I have the confirmation.
